findings.highlight: "I hear this is the biggest stuffed animal shop in town. I've never been here, since men aren't allowed."
findings.evidenceJa: 「町で一番品揃えのいいぬいぐるみ屋だってさ。男子禁制らしいんで、立ち寄った事はなかったけど」
findings.governingReading: The hearsay concerns the shop with the best selection of stuffed toys.

findings.highlight: I'm not sure why Saber liking lions is strange.
findings.evidenceJa: 何がおかしいって、ライオンが可愛いと思っている自分がおかしいと思っているセイバーがおかしい。
findings.governingReading: What is funny is Saber thinking herself strange for finding lions cute, not the taste itself.
findings.explanation: Laughing at her worry becomes not knowing why the preference is strange.

findings.highlight: I watch in silence as Saber stares at the stuffed animals while I worry about the dozen or so sets of prying eyes staring at me from around the store... I've never been so exhausted in my life as I am today.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーとぬいぐるみの睨めっこを無言で見守ったり、いったいどこからやってくるんだっていうぐらいの女の子の数に神経をすり減らしたり、とにかく今までで一番疲れた一時間だった。
findings.governingReading: He is worn down by so many girls that he wonders where they all come from.
findings.explanation: Unspecified crowds receive a dozen-or-so estimate.

findings.highlight: When you're mentally drained, the first part of your body that feels it is your legs.
findings.evidenceJa: 気疲れっていうのは、時に足にくるものなのだ。
findings.governingReading: Mental exhaustion can sometimes manifest in the legs.
findings.explanation: Mental fatigue sometimes affecting the legs becomes the legs always being first.
